subject: Request: Provisional Net-75 with phased invoice safeguards (Aperture Labs)
messages:
From: Sam Vega <s.vega@aperturelabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@aperturelabs.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Payment terms request: Net-75 + quarterly invoicing

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Aperture is excited to move forward with Redwood but our procurement team has one ask on billing to align with internal cashflow: a provisional Net-75 payment term and quarterly invoicing for the first 6 months of the contract.

We understand this is outside standard terms. Attached is a short spreadsheet with our proposed cadence and an updated SOW (Aperture_SOW_v3.pdf). Key points:
- Expected first invoice: Q1 2027 (covering onboarding/training)
- Quarterly invoices thereafter; each invoice to be due 75 days after issuance
- Total contracted value (year 1): $600,000; estimated monthly usage ramp included in the sheet

Can Redwood consider a provisional program (three-month pilot at Net-75) while we move finances internally to standard monthly terms? Procurement would require an escrow or holdback mechanism until go-live.

Appreciate your help — copying our procurement lead for context.

Best,
Sam Vega
Head of Procurement
Aperture Labs

Attachments: Aperture_SOW_v3.pdf (application/pdf), Payment_Term_Request.xlsx (spreadsheet/xlsx)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Vega <s.vega@aperturelabs.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment terms request: Net-75 + quarterly invoicing

Hi Sam,

Thanks — received and reviewed the attachments. I think Aperture is a strategic fit and I want to make progress quickly, but because Net-75 and quarterly invoicing are non-standard, I need an internal sign-off for a provisional arrangement.

Jonas/Marcus — can you weigh in on risk/cap/precedent here? My proposal is to escalate to finance and ask for a provisional Net-75 for 90 days with explicit safeguards (escrow/10% holdback, credit cap, and a defined review cadence). If we can get that approved, I will confirm with Aperture and draft an amendment to the SOW.

Sam — can you confirm Aperture is comfortable with a 90-day provisional window (we'd reassess after the pilot and then move to standard monthly or negotiated quarterly terms)? Also confirm who needs to sign on your side for the escrow/holdback.

-Mina
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment terms request: Net-75 + quarterly invoicing

Mina — looping in quick internal thoughts before we escalate.

On Wed, Dec 1, 2026 at 9:22 AM Sam Vega <s.vega@aperturelabs.com> wrote:
> Hi Mina,
>
> Thanks again for the conversation last week. Aperture is excited to move forward with Redwood but our procurement team has one ask on billing to align with internal cashflow: a provisional Net-75 payment term and quarterly invoicing for the first 6 months of the contract.
>
> We understand this is outside standard terms. Attached is a short spreadsheet with our proposed cadence and an updated SOW (Aperture_SOW_v3.pdf).

Key risks I see: credit exposure (peak AR could exceed our comfort), precedent set for similar scale deals, and operational complexity for invoicing cadence.

Suggested mitigations to include in the escalation to Finance/CFO:
- Provisional approval for a maximum 90-day period (auto-reverts unless exec renews)
- 10% holdback/escrow on each invoice until 60 days after customer go-live
- Credit ceiling of $150k or 25% of ARR whichever is lower
- Early-pay discount incentive (1% if paid within 15 days) to encourage faster collection
- Weekly usage and billing reconciliation during the provisional period

If everyone agrees, escalate to Olivia/Finance for explicit sign-off. I can draft the brief rationale.

-Jonas
Head of Revenue Operations
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sam Vega <s.vega@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Payment terms request: Net-75 + quarterly invoicing — request for provisional approval

Olga/Ben — forwarding Aperture's ask and our recommended guardrails. Short summary: Aperture (HS-48329) requests Net-75 and quarterly invoices for onboarding + initial term. We propose a provisional program (90 days) with the mitigations Jonas outlined.

Why we should consider: Aperture is a high-priority target in our sector and this deal accelerates product adoption in a strategic vertical. The financial exposure is manageable with the mitigations.

Requested action: executive sign-off from Finance (Olga) to allow a provisional Net-75 for 90 days under the following conditions:
- 10% escrow/holdback on each invoice until 60 days post go-live
- Credit cap $150,000
- Auto-reversion to standard terms after 90 days unless extended in writing
- DocuSign amendment to SOW to capture terms

Attachments included in thread for context. Happy to hop on a 20-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Mina

--- Forwarded message attached above ---
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sam Vega <s.vega@aperturelabs.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Dec 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Fwd: Payment terms request: Net-75 + quarterly invoicing — request for provisional approval

Mina / team,

Thanks for the context and the clear mitigations. I approve a provisional Net-75 for a 90-day pilot under the following conditions (please ensure these are in the DocuSign amendment before executing):

1) Holdback: 10% of each invoice to be held in escrow and released 60 days after successful go-live, defined as completion of onboarding checklist (Ops sign-off).
2) Credit limit: $150,000 hard cap on outstanding receivables during the provisional period. No additional exceptions without CFO approval.
3) Term: 90-day provisional window starting from first invoice date; auto-reverts to Redwood standard terms unless extended in writing by Finance.
4) Early-pay incentive: 1% discount if any invoice is paid within 15 days (to encourage faster collection).
5) Weekly reconciliation: Revenue Ops to run weekly usage/billing checks and flag discrepancies immediately.
6) Contract amendment: Legal/Contracts to prepare an amendment (DocuSign:DS-7721) capturing the above and the SOW references. Amendment must be signed prior to the first provisional invoice.

Finance will monitor exposure closely; Marcus/Ben please own the operational handoffs and timeline. Mina — once DocuSign is ready, confirm with Aperture and route through procurement for signature.

Olga Petrov
Chief Financial Officer
Redwood Inference
